description: This file defines a function 'createTeamSearchFunction' that generates an asynchronous search function for filtering teams based on user input. It filters the list of teams by matching the 'team_alias' property case-insensitively and formats the results for display.

methods.name: createTeamSearchFunction
methods.description: Creates a search function that filters a list of teams based on the search text and formats the output for use in UI components.
